Title: Am I the a-hole for getting mad that my boyfriend never tells me what he's doing?
Post Content: This has been an issue for months. Let me give some background information as to why this simple thing upsets me so much. Me and my boyfriend are long distance right now he's in California and I'm in Kansas. His school has really bad service so he can't really text very frequently if at all, which I understand no big deal but that ties in later. I'm always pretty aware that he is 2 hours behind me so he'd get out of school technically two hours later than me. But that honestly might make it worse because I know when he should be able to to text me. Being involved in my partners life is a big thing for me and helps me feel important to them. Not like going to all the events but getting to hear about their day. Getting to know them, their life, hobbies, and general schedule really helps me be able to love them the best I can and know when is the right time is to talk to them about long conversations without interrupting their day. It also helps me feel less like a "piece of the puzzle" in their life and more like a long term goal and an actual important part of their life. The entire time we've known each other and have been dating he's had this issue of just never telling me where he's going, what he's doing, or how long he'll be gone. He just disappeares and doesn't respond to text or calls until he's back home. I know he's struggled with mental health so I get a little worried that something happened when he doesn't respond for hours. He also does it very frequently where he'll text me then I text him back in less than a minute but then he disappeares. Also because of the time differences and his bad service in school that means we only get to talk for a couple hours a day if even that. And whenever we do he usually just wants to "have fun" if you know what I mean. It feels like this is all our relationship is about honestly. I've mentioned this to him many many times over many many weeks and I've seen no change. I've told him that I feel like just an object to him since we hardly ever talk and he only wants to "have fun". He won't like ghost me if I tell him no but he constantly asks. Either way off topic, I just don't feel very important to him since I never even know his life or what he's doing, we hardly talk for more than a couple hours total throughout the day, and he only ever wants to you know when we do talk. It's gotten to the point to where yelling at him, begging, pleading, negotiating, none of it works. He never tells me shit. I feel bad because I've started getting so angry about this problem but it's never even been close to getting fixed nomatter what I've done to bring it up or offer solutions. In my heart and my gut feeling I truly know he's the one but right now I barely even feel like his girlfriend and I don't know what to do to get him to tell me what the fuck he's doing. Even after he gets back he hardly tells me anything at all and I've just gotten so frustrated at this point. Am I the a-hole for getting so mad about it? And what tf should I do to get him to tell me when he's going to be gone for hours and what he's doing
